user.title: Add Raylogic MOD2U / MOD4U / MOD2F
user.description: Raylogic modules do not announce themselves on the network - let HA scan the LAN (recommended) or enter the IP address manually.

menu_options.scan: Scan network for Raylogic MOD modules

scan.title: Scan network
scan.description: Every host in the subnet(s) below will be checked on port 5550 (~10 s). Devices already added to HA (raylogic_mod or raylogic) are not touched. Only change the list if the modules are on a different subnet (comma-separated CIDR, e.g. 192.168.120.0/24).

pick.title: Raylogic modules found
pick.description: {count} module(s) responded. Choose one - the next form opens pre-filled with its detected Model/Area/First Channel (review and confirm). Run Add Integration again for the next module.

manual.title: Add Raylogic MOD2U / MOD4U / MOD2F
manual.description: Enter the device's IP address and choose the Device Model - MOD2U (2 channels, 1 pair), MOD4U (4 channels, 2 pairs) or MOD2F (single channel, fixed Fan type). The next step shows only as many channel fields as the selected model has (no Type dropdown is shown for the MOD2F - it is always a Fan; only the Area and channel number need to be entered).

channels.title: Configure channels
channels.description: Enter the Area shown on the Mod Settings screen (e.g. 12 or 16). Area = 0 only works when all channels are 'relay' (HA learns them by itself after each one is toggled once from the app/switch) - Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CCT require the Area to be entered manually. Channels come in 2 PAIRS: Pair 1 = Channel 1(+2), Pair 2 = Channel 3(+4) (only Pair 1 exists on the MOD2U). CCT (colour-temperature light) and Curtain BOTH use both physical channels of their pair internally - if Channel 1 Type = 'cct' or 'curtain' is chosen, the Channel 2 Type field is automatically ignored (a single entity is created), and the same applies to Channel 3/4. When choosing CCT, also select its Driver Mode - 'single' ('Single Driver' checked in the app) or 'double'.

data.channel_start: First Channel Number (usually 1, but check Raylogic GO app if channels don't start at 1)
data.channel_1_cct_mode: Channel 1 CCT Driver Mode (only if Channel 1 Type = cct)
data.channel_2_cct_mode: Channel 2 CCT Driver Mode (only if Channel 2 Type = cct)
data.channel_3_cct_mode: Channel 3 CCT Driver Mode (only if Channel 3 Type = cct)
data.channel_4_cct_mode: Channel 4 CCT Driver Mode (only if Channel 4 Type = cct)

discovery_confirm.title: New Raylogic MOD module found
discovery_confirm.description:
{name}

Add this module to Home Assistant? Model, Area and First Channel will be pre-filled in the next form - just review the channel types (relay/dimmer/fan/curtain/cct) and submit.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Check IP address and ensure device is powered on.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check logs for details.
error.area_required_for_non_relay: Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CCT channels require the Area (not 0) to be entered manually - auto-learn only works for Relay.
error.bad_subnet: Enter one or more valid IPv4 subnets in CIDR form, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 (max /22).
error.no_devices_found: No new Raylogic module was found on port 5550. Check that it is powered on and on this network (modules that are already added are not listed).
error.host_in_other_integration: This IP is already added in the 'raylogic' (main/DIN) integration. Do not add the same module to both integrations - two TCP connections to one device conflict with each other.

abort.already_configured: This Raylogic device is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: An add flow for this module is already in progress.

init.title: Configure Raylogic device
init.description: Change the channel type (relay/dimmer/fan/curtain/cct), Area or channel numbering here - there is no need to delete the device. The Device Model cannot be changed here - to change the model, delete the device and add it again. Remember: Pair 1 = Channel 1(+2), Pair 2 = Channel 3(+4) - Curtain/CCT consume both channels of a pair. Area scenes: the Raylogic GO app's area scenes in the format 'area:scene,scene; area:scene' (e.g. '12:1,2,3; 5:1,4') - entering them on any ONE device is enough; scene entities + a scene dropdown are created for each area. Empty = no scenes.

data.auto_discovery: Auto-discover new modules (background LAN scan every 30 min, whole integration)

error.area_required_for_non_relay: Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CCT require the Area to be entered manually (0 only works for Relay LEARN mode).
error.bad_scene_map: Could not parse the area scenes - the format is 'area:scene,scene; area:scene' (area 1-16, scene 1-64), e.g. '12:1,2,3; 5:1,4'.
error.host_in_other_integration: This IP is already added in the 'raylogic' (main/DIN) integration - the MOD entry cannot point to that module (two TCP connections to one device conflict with each other).

recall_scene.name: Recall area scene
recall_scene.description: Recall a Raylogic GO app area scene through every connected MOD module.
